findings.claim: NOW 10-K FY2025 風險因子：受海關法管轄，部分情況須自付美國及他國進口關稅，較高進口關稅會提高營運成本；亦受出口管制與經濟制裁法約束，俄烏衝突下可能有更廣的制裁與出口限制。
findings.excerpt: In addition, we are subject to customs laws that may impose tariffs on us, either directly or indirectly. This includes tariffs imposed by the U.S. government and other countries on imports, which we are responsible to pay in certain circumstances. Higher tariffs on imports related to our operations could increase our operating costs.

findings.claim: NOW 10-K FY2025 MD&A：管理層稱未因關稅等總體事件而影響流動性或營運與財務狀況。
findings.excerpt: We have not experienced any impact to our liquidity or to our current and projected business operations and financial condition due to recent macroeconomic events.

reg_tariff_export.note: 另搜 ServiceNow 與中國出口管制／實體清單，結果未提及 ServiceNow（僅泛述中國對其他美企的管制）；無 NOW 特定來源。
